summary: Dependency-free SVG heatmap: a rows × columns grid where color intensity grows with the value, with two-dimensional keyboard navigation, a min–max scale and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Values across two categorical dimensions: day × hour, channel × device, team × month.
Spotting peaks, dips and recurring patterns in a matrix at a glance.
Moderately sized matrices (tens of rows and columns).
whenNotToUse: Values that must be compared precisely: color intensity is approximate, use BarChart or a table.
Trends over time for a few series: use LineChart.
Signed values (positive/negative): the scale is sequential, single-color.
Very large matrices (thousands of cells): they need a dedicated visualization.

props.name: values
props.description: Value matrix: values[r][c] maps to rows[r] × columns[c]. null is a cell with no data.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: description
props.description: Visible description below the title (period, unit, source).

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Value format (percent, currency, compact…) in the current locale.

props.name: cellHeight
props.description: Height of each row in px; cell width follows the container.

props.name: colorIndex
props.description: Data color of the scale (0 = --dc-color-data-1 … 5 = --dc-color-data-6, cyclic).

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Color scale from minimum to maximum with formatted values.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses rounder, more spaced cells and a gradient inside the cell; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area (and then to the table button).
Next / previous column in the same row (the first press activates the first cell).
Next / previous row in the same column.
First / last cell of the row.

accessibility: <figure> + <figcaption> structure; the chart area is a focusable role="group", named by the title and described by a hint on using the arrow keys.
Each keyboard move announces "row · column: value" in an aria-live="polite" region; the active cell is outlined and its labels are bold.
The SVG is decorative (aria-hidden): the full matrix is in the table (rows and columns with headers) opened by the "Show data table" button.
Cells with no data are not just “lighter”: they show a dash, distinguishable from a minimum value.
In forced-colors, cells use CanvasText with the same opacity and the active outline uses Highlight.
responsive: Width is measured with ResizeObserver (falls back to 560 px in SSR); columns shrink and labels are thinned out when space runs short.
Height depends on the number of rows (cellHeight × rows).
Entrance animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Scale color via colorIndex (tokens --dc-color-data-1…6); empty cells and background use --dc-color-surface-subtle.
Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) rounds and spaces the cells and paints them with a gradient toward --dc-color-accent-default.
commonMistakes: values rows whose length differs from columns: missing cells are treated as empty.
Using 0 instead of null for missing data, which then becomes indistinguishable from a low value.
Relying on color alone for critical values: add the data table or a text summary.

limits: Linear, single-color sequential scale (no diverging or threshold scales).
Column labels are thinned out, not rotated; text width is estimated.
The grid is still drawn left to right in RTL.
